##: Scoop manifest for the FULL Ray headless CLI bundle (ray-headless-windows-x64[-<version>].zip).
Per release, fill in: (1) version, (2) architecture.64bit.url, (3) architecture.64bit.hash
(the SHA256 printed by build-cli-bundle.ps1), and the checkver/autoupdate URLs to point at
your release host. x64 only. When adding to a Scoop bucket, name the file 'ray-headless.json'.
Install:  scoop install ray-headless   (or:  scoop install <bucket>/ray-headless )
description: Ray headless CLI - on-device subtitles, translation, narration, and stem separation.
notes: Run 'ray help' to get started. 'ray serve' starts the local API server;
'ray run <file>' does a one-shot subtitle job.
Models and results are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Ray.
